# NicheGate Mini Brand Identity Guide

## Brand character

NicheGate is a premium creative resource shop built around the idea of entering a more specific, more useful world. The visual identity should feel **architectural, imaginative, polished, and quietly electric** rather than loud or overly technical.

The supplied logo is the hero asset. Its split teal-and-pink gateway N creates a recognizable signature that can work across storefronts, product covers, profile images, and social content.

![NicheGate logo on black](https://private-us-east-1.manuscdn.com/sessionFile/sy5kSPQRXBy8VFo4eIbfFh/sandbox/W9IVgptzqwFTQYlJG7xWFF-images_1788442011156_na1fn_L2hvbWUvdWJ1bnR1L25pY2hlZ2F0ZV9sb2dvX29uX2JsYWNr.png?&Key-Pair-Id=K2QY5QTL8JSY6C&Signature=MEUCIBQI8kQSQDyplyJql6P6nl6S4cyLgmvVP37rQT3z61kwAiEAzYaskxc74MpWXGIsn0xyJ0QN1ptoGhRW6NX~tcXXFyU_)

## Core palette

| Color | Suggested digital value | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Deep Black | `#09090C` | Primary background, contrast, and premium foundation |
| Electric Teal | `#19D7D1` | Left-side brand energy, highlights, links, and active states |
| Soft Hot Pink | `#F542A5` | Right-side brand energy, emphasis, launches, and calls to action |
| Warm White | `#F4F0F0` | Type, linework, and breathing room |
| Muted Charcoal | `#1B1D24` | Secondary panels, product cards, and subtle tonal variation |

Use black as the visual base. Teal and pink should appear as a deliberate split or paired accent rather than as random decoration. White or warm-white type should carry most informational copy so the identity remains easy to read.

## Typography direction

Use a refined high-contrast display serif or elegant editorial display face for the wordmark and major headlines. Pair it with a clean geometric sans-serif for product names, navigation, descriptions, and small labels.

| Application | Typography treatment |
|---|---|
| Logo | Use the supplied `NICHEGATE` artwork without retyping or altering the letterforms |
| Storefront headline | High-contrast editorial serif, uppercase or title case, generous tracking |
| Product title | Geometric sans-serif, medium or semibold weight |
| Supporting copy | Neutral sans-serif, regular weight, generous line spacing |
| Small labels | Uppercase sans-serif with moderate letter spacing |

A good working pairing is an elegant display serif such as **Cormorant Garamond, DM Serif Display, or Playfair Display** with a restrained sans-serif such as **Manrope, Inter, or Plus Jakarta Sans**. The display face supplies personality; the sans-serif keeps digital products and storefront information practical.

## Etsy banner application

The Etsy direction uses a centered logo lockup against a dark architectural arch. The teal energy stays on the left and pink stays on the right, creating a recognizable NicheGate split without competing with the logo. Keep the center visually calm so the logo remains the first thing seen.

![NicheGate Etsy banner](https://private-us-east-1.manuscdn.com/sessionFile/sy5kSPQRXBy8VFo4eIbfFh/sandbox/W9IVgptzqwFTQYlJG7xWFF-images_1788442011156_na1fn_L2hvbWUvdWJ1bnR1L25pY2hlZ2F0ZV9ldHN5X2Jhbm5lcg.png?__&Key-Pair-Id=K2QY5QTL8JSY6C&Signature=MEUCIQCKlVPDJwO76GcdopbeRtBonFzUPDcwBLOJO1Fx6~4q7QIgJidtfXd94bfgs6YTZlSvDKIh-1pnc8piwO5ccEEcB0A_)

Recommended treatment: use the banner as the main storefront atmosphere, keep supporting text short, and avoid placing busy product thumbnails directly behind the logo.

## Gumroad banner application

The Gumroad direction is slightly more atmospheric and spacious. It uses a softer teal-to-pink field with subtle grid and arch references, allowing the logo to feel like a doorway into the product collection.

![NicheGate Gumroad banner](https://private-us-east-1.manuscdn.com/sessionFile/sy5kSPQRXBy8VFo4eIbfFh/sandbox/W9IVgptzqwFTQYlJG7xWFF-images_1788442011156_na1fn_L2hvbWUvdWJ1bnR1L25pY2hlZ2F0ZV9ndW1yb2FkX2Jhbm5lcg.png?_&Key-Pair-Id=K2QY5QTL8JSY6C&Signature=MEUCIQCelNCQhWsmEN49zQL7i1Cd19MWh5Q6szk9ibZ7MUTC3wIgJPq0lN064BVDEtrlWHFJ0zY6KIsHVCTx8RTgSJV-R9o_)

Recommended treatment: pair the banner with short language such as “Templates for the oddly specific” or “Systems for your next idea.” Keep the headline separate from the logo lockup so the brand remains uncluttered.

## Profile-picture system

For profile images, use the full logo against the dark split-color portal background when the platform allows enough room for the wordmark. For smaller circular crops, prioritize the central gateway N and remove the tagline before reducing the artwork.

![NicheGate profile icon](https://private-us-east-1.manuscdn.com/sessionFile/sy5kSPQRXBy8VFo4eIbfFh/sandbox/W9IVgptzqwFTQYlJG7xWFF-images_1788442011156_na1fn_L2hvbWUvdWJ1bnR1L25pY2hlZ2F0ZV9wcm9maWxlX2ljb24.png?_&Key-Pair-Id=K2QY5QTL8JSY6C&Signature=MEQCICMBf28kX23TeR4ffVa2I0z~Ip3V8AXu5cypC2uxLXuAAiBF6iuvZunvxdJkA99AYEqSGPVNBFpRVwBaiP52H5fMrg__)

## Social icon system

Use the same portal language across social profiles, but allow a little more decorative linework and glow than on product thumbnails. The icon should remain centered, high contrast, and recognizable when reduced.

![NicheGate social icon](https://private-us-east-1.manuscdn.com/sessionFile/sy5kSPQRXBy8VFo4eIbfFh/sandbox/W9IVgptzqwFTQYlJG7xWFF-images_1788442011156_na1fn_L2hvbWUvdWJ1bnR1L25pY2hlZ2F0ZV9zb2NpYWxfaWNvbg.png?__&Key-Pair-Id=K2QY5QTL8JSY6C&Signature=MEYCIQDGwp98Ernlfs6yipnhaMhLwxctJ~PZfsTothu118svkgIhAJPMddGSxj3LXga7mAXJJv0EedQ7o9SyYIuEf3vyuQgG)

## Product-listing watermark

Use the watermark as a quiet ownership mark rather than a headline. Place it in a lower corner over product previews, keep opacity low, and avoid covering spreadsheet formulas, template layouts, or important screenshots.

![NicheGate product watermark](https://private-us-east-1.manuscdn.com/sessionFile/sy5kSPQRXBy8VFo4eIbfFh/sandbox/W9IVgptzqwFTQYlJG7xWFF-images_1788442011156_na1fn_L2hvbWUvdWJ1bnR1L25pY2hlZ2F0ZV9wcm9kdWN0X3dhdGVybWFyaw.png?&Key-Pair-Id=K2QY5QTL8JSY6C&Signature=MEUCIFYrZZ9-C-dsBPkke-RCdUkWYKQvhaSex876NyFjQ9Q~AiEAsvTbEZmsPe1iEYlnT4XQTxlchtuwinnM5-yLUW0RijI_)

## Consistency rules

The logo should always retain its teal-left and pink-right logic. Avoid rotating, stretching, recoloring one half independently, adding heavy drop shadows, or placing the mark on a busy image. When a product cover already contains strong color, use the black-and-white logo treatment or a dark translucent panel behind it.

The strongest NicheGate visual formula is **dark architectural space + elegant white typography + teal/pink split energy + one clear gateway motif**. This keeps the brand recognizable without making every asset look identical.
